title: Tell Us Your Vision
description: Share your dates, interests, budget, and who's travelling. No detail is too small.

title: Receive Your Bespoke Itinerary
description: Within 48 hours, we'll send a detailed proposal with accommodation options, routing, and pricing.

title: Refine & Confirm
description: We adjust until it's perfect. Once you're happy, a 30% deposit secures everything.

title: Pre-Trip Preparation
description: We send packing lists, visa guidance, and a final itinerary. Your guide calls to introduce themselves.

title: Experience Africa
description: From airport pickup to final farewell, every moment is handled. You just need to be present.
